observations.code_quote: Route security-related changes by merge status and disclosure risk: fix problems introduced by an open public PR in that PR, keep fixes that would disclose an existing exploitable weakness private until deployment, and make safe, non-secret fixes in `PostHog/posthog`. See [Routing security fixes](.agents/security.md#routing-security-fixes).
observations.behavior: Replaces absolute prohibition with conditional routing rules for where security fixes are submitted.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes documentation governing agent behavior regarding repository selection; does not modify PostHog application code.

observations.code_quote: Choose the repository by **merge status and disclosure risk**, not by whether the code touches security. Before creating a branch or PR, check whether the affected code is already on `master` or deployed, and whether a public diff, test, or description would reveal an exploitable weakness before the fix is deployed.
observations.behavior: Updates guidance to use disclosure-risk assessment rather than blanket exclusion from public repo.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation change only; no implementation or configuration enforcement present.

observations.code_quote: Route each approved fix and its reproducer test by merge status and disclosure risk. Fix a weakness introduced only by an open public PR in that PR. Keep an existing exploitable weakness private when publishing the fix would disclose it before deployment. See [Routing security fixes](../../security.md#routing-security-fixes).
observations.behavior: Clarifies workflow instructions without adding executable checks or branching logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation-only update; no changes to CI, tests, or shared infrastructure.

observations.limitations: All hunks reside exclusively under .agents/ directory, which appears to be internal tooling documentation for agents rather than PostHog production or shared backend/frontend code. No evidence of actual application behavior, dependency, or runtime impact.
